patch_list: Disable Acceptable Ads whitelist

Replaces Opera's hidden partner whitelists (Google/Yandex measurement, Taboola, gambling and shopping affiliates, AppsFlyer/Adjust/Kochava/CJ tracking domains) with empty filter lists, so the built-in ad blocker actually blocks them.
Disable Acceptable Ads whitelist

Disable ad modules
Prevents Opera from loading its bundled third-party ad network modules (Liftoff/Vungle, Mintegral, Pangle/ByteDance) by breaking the reflective class lookup used by the ad mediation layer.

Remove sponsored Speed Dial
